crossRefs.note: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus…
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after…
In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of…
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and…
I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

translations.web: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
translations.bsb: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
translations.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
translations.asv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one; but God is one.
